spec_match.rationale: Each gate reproduces a normative refusal: transient activation (NotAllowedError), the 'translator' permissions policy, IDL required members, tag validation, the unsupported pair, and an aborted signal.

interactive.rationale: Seven Run buttons plus Run all; every gate calls the real API and compares the exception name.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index blurb describes exactly what the page does and the Android angle it covers.

edge_cases.rationale: This page is the edge-case portfolio; the enterprise policy is labelled as an inference, not a probe.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5106126157905920 and the spec section.

conformance.rationale: Gates 2,3,4,6 are mirrored one-to-one in the feature conformance suite.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chrome for Testing 153 headless (Linux) via Playwright at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch; every control clicked; 0 console errors, 0 failed requests, no horizontal overflow, no tap target under 44px. chrome-devtools-mcp is NOT available in this environment, so browser verification is headless Playwright + screenshots, not DevTools MCP. Observed 6/6 gates match the spec (NotAllowedError with no gesture after 6 s; iframe 'unavailable' + NotAllowedError; RangeError; TypeError; en->kl NotSupportedError; AbortError), and policy signature 'not blocking'.

telemetry_health.rationale: One assert per gate; the policy card asserts without claiming a pass.

design_system.rationale: Only design-system variables for text/background; AA pairs (black/ivory, charcoal/stone, emerald-dark/stone, rose on stone for bold status text); button overrides set both background and color.

accessibility.rationale: Native labelled controls, polite live regions and visible focus. The accessibility tree was not inspected with chrome-devtools-mcp (unavailable here).

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 or 1280x800; controls wrap; 44px targets; screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Observe the TranslatorAPIAllowed=false signature on a managed Android device
openQuestions.detail: Set the policy via a managed profile and confirm every pair reports 'unavailable' and create() logs 'The translation is disallowed by policy.'

openQuestions.title: Inspect the accessibility tree with chrome-devtools-mcp
openQuestions.detail: Labels and live regions were set per guidance and checked in the DOM, but not inspected in the DevTools accessibility tree because chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this environment (rule 7b).

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow on narrow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: 44x44 touch targets, components that wrap to their container, content never clipped down to 320px.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Controls use flex-wrap and auto-fit minmax(min(100%,12rem),1fr) grids; buttons and selects have min-height 44px; tables sit in a focusable overflow-x region.

guidanceConsulted.query: live region status readouts for async API results
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce changing state through text in a polite live region, and use native controls with labels.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every readout is role=status aria-live=polite; selects have <label for>; focus-visible outlines use --accent-blue.

guidanceConsulted.query: permissions policy iframe allow attribute feature detection
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Delegate powerful features to frames explicitly via allow=, and default to least privilege.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The denied-frame gate uses allow="translator 'none'" on a hidden, aria-hidden, non-focusable same-origin srcdoc frame, which is removed after the test.

guidanceConsulted.query: inform users of on-device AI model download progress
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Guide is gated as a volatile feature (needs `npx modern-web-guidance@latest set-allow-volatile-features`). The gate was not bypassed.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Exception: the user explicitly named the Translator API. Code was grounded in the spec IDL and Chromium source instead, and is unverified against the gated guide. A human can unlock it with `npx modern-web-guidance@latest set-allow-volatile-features` and re-review.

summary: Android-angle concept for the Translator API (feature 5106126157905920). All API calls are real, with honest fallbacks, and nothing downloads without an explicit tap. Verified headless in Chrome 153 on Linux; the on-device success path still needs a real Android Chrome 161 run.
